conservation_status.description: Sinapidendron angustifolium is assessed as Critically Endangered. Its extent of occurrence (EOO) is less than 100 km2, its area of occupancy (AOO) is suspected to be 10 km2 or less, the population is severely fragmented and there is a continuing decline in the quality and extent of the habitat due to development pressures. Research is needed to determine the exact population size and regular monitoring should be undertaken with management interventions where necessary.
